how.title: WPI - How to Apply: Requirements & Steps

test_policy.notes: Test-optional (applicants choose whether scores are considered; no-harm practice). SAT is superscored; ACT best composite is used; science section not required. Self-reporting allowed; official scores only if you enroll. Scores are not used for merit scholarships. Last published middle 50% (fall 2021 entrants who submitted): SAT 1340-1480, ACT 30-34.

requirements.notes: One teacher and one counselor recommendation, official transcripts (first marking period grades or mid-year report highly recommended). Early Decision applicants submit the ED Agreement form. Page says all first-year candidates use the Common Application. International students applying for need-based aid submit only the CSS Profile (no FAFSA); domestic need-based applicants need both.

deadlines.label: Early Decision I
deadlines.notes: Binding. Notification by mid December (no exact date). Admitted ED students get a minimum merit scholarship of $25,000 per year. Need-based aid documents also due Nov 1.

deadlines.label: Early Decision II
deadlines.notes: Binding. Notification by mid February (no exact date).

deadlines.label: Early Action I
deadlines.notes: Non-binding. Decision by mid December; reply by May 1.

deadlines.label: Regular Decision
deadlines.notes: Decision by mid March (ED I deferrals are notified before March 15).

english_policy.waiver_notes: Citizens of an English-speaking country who attended an English-speaking high school for four years may be exempt; contact admissions. Initialview or Vericant interviews are only a supplement.

english.notes: Recommended score for tests taken after 2026-01-21.

aid.notes: Need-aware at the application stage; limited need-based assistance for international first-year and transfer students (CSS Profile due by the admissions deadline). WPI says competitive international applicants typically contribute at least $25,000 per year. Up to two WPI International Leadership Awards per year (up to full tuition and fees, possible $12,000 housing allowance); all admitted fall-entry international students are considered automatically.
